text: Seabrook Town recovers the ball deep in their own half on the left side through Aiden Quinlan’s interception. Quinlan sends a long ball diagonally forward and to his right, reaching Kian Adeyemi near the right flank of the attacking third. Adeyemi advances centrally a few metres before passing short to Tariq Marlowe positioned near the centre-left. Marlowe threads a precise through ball into the penalty area on the left side, where Callum Varga runs onto it about 8.5 metres from Harbour City’s goal. Varga strikes the ball with his foot and scores, leveling the score at 2-2 with this decisive finish inside the box.
